verdict.rationale: The only evidence of an in-product AI assistant is a single mention of 'Canva AI', which users can design with by pasting in links for more context. That implies a built-in AI design assistant but does not show what tasks can be delegated to it. The MCP server material covers external AI assistants connecting to Canva, which is a different story, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of what tasks the built-in assistant can perform, how users delegate multi-step work to it, its scope and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Bring content into Canva AI by pasting links from other platforms to design with more context.
